_comment: Deckard DEMO policy — copied to $HOME/.deckard/demo/policy.json by `just demo` (install-if-absent; your edits there are never clobbered). NOT for mainnet. All caps are wei, as DECIMAL strings. Comment keys (_comment*) are ignored by the loader (Policy has no deny_unknown_fields).
_comment_hero: per_tx_cap 0.1 ETH lets the hero `shield 0.02 ETH` auto-allow on the Sepolia fork (chain 11155111 -> mainnet guardrail inactive; require_approval=OverCap allows within-cap). Shield > 0.1 ETH (or cumulative > 0.5 ETH/day) -> NeedsApproval, the clean over-cap example.
_comment_spent_today: Always reset to 0 by the daemon on load (spend tracking is in-memory). Value here is cosmetic.
_comment_allow_to: EMPTY = any recipient allowed; the per-tx/daily caps still apply. Shield routes to the wallet's own 0zk address, so an allowlist is unnecessary for the demo.
_comment_auto_shield_min: 0.01 ETH. Advisory only — the agent reads it to decide whether to PROPOSE an auto-shield; the policy gate does not switch on it.
_comment_require_approval: One of: Never | OverCap | Always. OverCap = within-cap auto-allows; over-cap raises NeedsApproval — no approval card in this alpha, so lower the amount under the per-tx cap or raise the cap here.
_comment_revoked: Always reset to false by the daemon on load (a daemon boots armed; STOP is a live action, never a persisted flag).
